news.title:
Cello World guides for 10–12% revenue growth and 250 bps EBITDA margin expansion in FY27, driven by steelware, glassware units, and Cello pen integration.
Shares fell 36% YoY, trading at Rs. 386.05 with a market cap of Rs. 8,527.3 crore and a P/E of 25.3 despite healthy cash flows.

Investec maintains a Sell on Cello World, reducing TP to ₹435 from ₹515 due to earnings downgrade risks.
Factors include rising competition, import pressure, receivables rationalization, weaker margins, and lower PAT estimates.

news.title: Dividend of ₹1.50 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹1.50 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 31st July 2026 Payment date: 6th September 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.4%, which is about the same as the industry average. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (10% earnings payout ratio) but not adequately covered by cash flows (93% cash payout ratio). The dividend has not increased over the past 2 years but payments have been stable during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 38% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.70 (down from ₹15.50 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹23.8b (up 9.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.32b (down 2.2% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 14% (down from 16% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.8% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Consumer Durables industry in India.
